shortDescription: Manages isis interface configuration on HUAWEI CloudEngine devices.

options.name: bfdblocken
options.description: Blocking interfaces to dynamically create BFD features. The value is a bool type.

options.name: bfdstaticen
options.description: Configure static BFD on a specific interface enabled with ISIS. The value is a bool type.

options.name: instance_id
options.description: Specifies the id of a isis process. The value is a number of 1 to 4294967295.

options.name: level1cost
options.description: Specifies the link cost of the interface when performing Level-1 SPF calculation. The value is a number of 0 to 16777215.

options.name: level1dispriority
options.description: the dispriority of the level1. The value is a number of 1 to 127.

options.name: level2cost
options.description: Specifies the link cost of the interface when performing Level-2 SPF calculation. The value is a number of 0 to 16777215.

options.name: level2dispriority
options.description: the dispriority of the level1. The value is a number of 1 to 127.

options.name: p2pnegotiationmode
options.description: Set the P2P neighbor negotiation type.

options.name: p2ppeeripignore
options.description: When the P2P hello packet is received, no IP address check is performed. The value is a bool type.

options.name: ppposicpcheckenable
options.description: Interface for setting PPP link protocol to check OSICP negotiation status. The value is a bool type.

options.name: silentcost
options.description: Specifies whether the routing cost of the silent interface is 0. The value is a bool type.

options.name: silentenable
options.description: enable the interface can send isis message. The value is a bool type.

options.name: snpacheck
options.description: Enable SNPA check for LSPs and SNPs. The value is a bool type.

options.name: state
options.description: Determines whether the config should be present or not on the device.

options.name: typep2penable
options.description: Simulate the network type of the interface as P2P. The value is a bool type.
